WITH total_count AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) as total FROM telescopes
),
status_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    powerstatus,
    COUNT(*) as count
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY powerstatus
),
status_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    sc.powerstatus,
    sc.count,
    sc.count * 100.0 / tc.total as share
  FROM status_counts sc
  CROSS JOIN total_count tc
),
avg_share_calc AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share
  FROM status_shares
)
SELECT 
  SUM(ss.count) as total_telescopes,
  AVG(ss.share) as average_share,
  AVG(ss.share - a.avg_share) as how_far_above_average
FROM status_shares ss
CROSS JOIN avg_share_calc a
WHERE ss.share > a.avg_share
